newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Tap says Harriet field gets gas order.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Tap says Harriet field gets gas order.

text.p: Tap Oil NL said on Wednesday its part-owned Harriet joint venture has entered into a heads of agreement to supply natural gas to energy and building products group Boral Ltd
Tap holds a 12.2 percent interest in the Harriet joint venture through its wholly owned subsidiary Tap (Harriet) Pty Ltd.
Tap said it anticipates supplies of gas to Boral will commence on April 1 1998.
Boral initially will require 7.2 terajoules (tj) a day in 1998, increasing to 13 tj a day in subsequent years, Tap said.

The gas will most likely be produced initially from the developed Harriet gas fields offshore Western Australia state and subsequently from the Wonnich gas field, which was discovered by the Harriet joint venture in 1995.

The other Harriet joint venture partners are Apache Energy Ltd the operator, with 22.5 percent, Mobil Corp 25 percent, Kuwait Foreign Petroleum Exploration Corp 19.3 percent, Novus Petroleum Ltd 12.5 percent, Hardy Oil and Gas Plc 8.4 percent and New World Oil Development Pty Ltd with 0.1 percent.
